detected_issues.issue: The pipeline constructs a next-lap target by shifting the tyre wear series by one row within each race/driver group and then retains a legacy alias including the future peak value. This is a valid target definition only if it is never reused as a feature; it was also being treated as a permitted column in the model pipeline and documented as a legacy feature.
detected_issues.why_it_is_leakage: The model could learn from a value that is only available after the prediction moment if the alias is present in the feature matrix or validation split.
detected_issues.fix: The target is still computed as a causal next-lap delta, but the explicit feature allowlist rejects any target-proxy columns such as future_tire_wear_pct and next_lap_wear_increment in the feature matrix. The leakage audit now fails if they appear.

detected_issues.issue: The prior leakage detector relied on substring matching such as 'future', 'next_', and 'status'. This is brittle and can miss edge cases or over-filter variables incorrectly.
detected_issues.why_it_is_leakage: A weak audit does not protect against future-derived columns that are not obviously named as future/next values.
detected_issues.fix: A strict allowlist-based policy is enforced in src/f1_tyre/strict_feature_policy.py. Unknown or forbidden features raise a ValueError before training.

detected_issues.issue: Rolling features must use only information available up to the current lap. The project code is correctly using a prior shift before rolling, but it was not protected by an automated causal regression test.
detected_issues.why_it_is_leakage: Without a regression test, future rows can silently leak into the rolling window.
detected_issues.fix: The synthetic regression test in tests/test_causal_leakage.py verifies that the rolling statistic at lap 4 does not incorporate lap 5 and that the lagged window is causal.

audit_findings.true_prediction_moment: At the end of lap t, predict the degradation increment on lap t+1 using only information known at that time.
audit_findings.causal_boundary: Rows are valid only when the next row belongs to the same race_id and driver_id, the lap increases by one, the tyre_age_laps increases by exactly one, and the compound stays the same.
audit_findings.rolling_policy: For every rolling feature use shift(1) before rolling and never rolling on an unshifted or future-aligned window.

verification.evidence: The project regression suite passed after the leakage guard and causal tests were added.

original_r2_status.statement: The original 0.9999 R² is not treated as final performance because the project did not have a strict race-disjoint holdout and feature-policy enforcement. The new implementation explicitly rejects target-proxy columns and enforces an allowlist before training.
original_r2_status.fresh_holdout_metric: No claim is made for a new final unseen-race holdout R² without a fully implemented race-disjoint training/validation/test split and retrained artifacts. The repository now includes the causal guardrails needed to produce such a metric honestly.
